newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Costello sees better jobs outlook.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Costello sees better jobs outlook.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Thursday that recent employment data indicated that the jobs outlook would improve in the near future.

"The ABS (Australian Bureau of Statistics) job vacancies data taken together with ANZ job vacancies series are supportive of a strengthening in relation to employment and employment prospects over coming months," Costello told Parliament.
"We will continue, of course, to take those policy measures which will be supportive of growing employment in the Australian economy," he said.
The ABS jobs vacancies data released earlier on Thursday showed an adjusted rise of 2.7 percent in the three months to May which followed a fall of 0.9 percent in the three months to February.
May job vacancies were 7.7 percent higher than a year ago.
Australia's unemployment rate has remained stubbornly high, standing at an adjusted 8.8 percent in May.
The 1997/98 budget forecast that there would be a jobless rate of 8.0 percent in the 1998 June quarter.
